verdicts.reason: A has a sound banner structure: the book sits on the left and the card holds the headline and CTA in a clear order. Its flaws are a tiny, unreadable Inkwell & Lantern logo crammed into the card's top-left corner, the card running into the right and bottom canvas edges, and fine print squeezed beside the CTA. B is broken: the 'See the Schedule' button covers the body copy ('Tea and t…'), the body text and fine print are cut off at the right and bottom edges, and the card runs off the canvas with no margins.
